resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wooden per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts, log per the Rex's page. The story reports both.
7,760 ft per firelookout.com; a 1933 newspaper account quoted on the Rex's page gives 8,400 ft for the station. The story gives both and picks neither.

notes_for_editor: Location: the FFLA listing (firelookout.org) gives 45.20869, -115.24185, which matches the record. The second pair in the brief, 45.24117, -115.25414, did not appear in any page I read, so the coordinates were left alone. No photo added: firelookout.com credits a photo to Richard Holm but gives no image URL. Left out as not about the lookout's history: a 1933 lost-child report at the station, and a Ramey Ridge murder case between two miners (intermountainhistories.org/items/show/305, seen only in a search snippet). No source describes the site today, so the story says so.
